simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גַּת־הַחֵפֶר (H1662) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: גַּת־הַחֵפֶר (Gath-ha-Chêpher) means Gath-Chepher , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 14 25.

definitions.full: H1662. Gath -hachepher הַחֵ֫פֶר גַּת 2Kin 14:25 ( wine-press of digging home of Jonah, prophet; חֵ֫פֶר גִּתָּ֖הֿ Josh 19:13 , perhaps modern El-Meshhed , approximately 3 miles east of north from Nazareth, Rob BR ii. 350 Bd Pal 252 .
definitions.rootNote: or (abridged) גִּתָּה־חֵפֶר ; from 1660 and 2658 with the article inserted; wine-press of (the) well;
